envelope.description: The hook registry and its run point

body.title: The hook registry and its run point
body.summary: Add src/daemon/tools/hooks.ts with registerToolHook (duplicate, empty id and alias refusal), runToolHooks (resolved tool.id lookup, a structuredClone of input and result per hook, serial run, guarded failure text cut to 500 characters, clone failure reported per hook, per-hook log line) and the test reset seam; export registerToolHook from src/daemon/tools/index.ts. Create src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts with the registry and run-point unit tests; t3, t4 and t5 extend the same file so every proving test the LLD names lives there.
acceptanceChecks: registerToolHook throws on a duplicate toolId+id, an empty id or toolId, and an alias of an already registered tool
runToolHooks runs hooks in registration order, one at a time, and a failing hook does not stop the next
a null-prototype throw, a throwing toString and an empty message give the fixed fallback text and nothing throws out of runToolHooks
a hook that mutates nested result.data, with or without then throwing, leaves the original untouched
an uncloneable result reports that hook as failed and the rest still run
a message over 500 characters is cut to 500

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: registerToolHook appends in order and refuses a duplicate toolId+id and an empty id or toolId
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: registerToolHook refuses an alias in place of a canonical id
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: runToolHooks runs hooks one at a time
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: runToolHooks catches a throw or rejection, cuts a long message to 500 characters and gives each hook its own structuredClone of input and result

src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: failure text for a null-prototype object, a value with a throwing toString and an empty message falls back to a fixed non-empty text, and building it does not throw

src/daemon/tools/__tests__/tool-hooks.test.ts: a hook that mutates nested result.data, with and without then throwing, leaves the caller's result untouched; a result that cannot be cloned reports that hook as failed and still runs the rest
